hooks.command: jq -r '.tool_input.command' | grep -qE 'push.*--force' && echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"git push --force bloqueado — pide autorizacion explicita"}}' || echo '{}'

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command'); if echo "$c" | grep -qE '^for\b' && echo "$c" | grep -qE 'rm[[:space:]]+-rf|git[[:space:]]+reset[[:space:]]+--hard|git[[:space:]]+clean[[:space:]]+-f'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"hookEventName":"PreToolUse","permissionDecision":"deny","permissionDecisionReason":"for-loop con comando peligroso (rm -rf / git reset --hard / git clean -f) bloqueado — pide autorizacion explicita"}}'; else echo '{}'; fi
